optimizers.selection: lowest mean final validation cross-entropy across the three fixed seeds; three rates per optimizer

architectures.optimizer: adam; reuse the validation-selected rate from the optimizer experiment, no architecture-specific retuning

regularization.objective: mean cross-entropy + lambda/2 * sum of squared Linear weights; biases excluded; Adam weight_decay=0
regularization.early_stopping: causal patience rule on validation; continue training only to show the counterfactual long trajectory; retain the checkpoint selected before the virtual stop

double_descent.model: one frozen random ReLU hidden layer; fit only p output coefficients by minimum-norm least squares or ridge
double_descent.ridge_objective: mean squared error + lambda * squared norm of output weights
double_descent.display: median and interquartile range over all twenty prescribed seeds; no seed selection, no clipping of stored metrics

audit_policy: freeze optimizer rates, all model checkpoints and code before opening the new internal audit; never use the official IMDb test in this extension
interpretation: didactic controlled experiments, not an architecture benchmark or a claim of universal optimizer superiority; synthetic double descent is not evidence of double descent in the IMDb CNN
